release.scope: Checkout and payments flow, mobile app v9.0

requirements.description: Checkout completes in three taps or fewer on the mobile app.
A transient payment decline can be retried without losing the cart.
Cart contents resynchronize correctly after a brief offline period.

testCases.description: Complete checkout end to end with a saved payment method.
Force a transient decline, then retry payment and confirm cart integrity.
Add items while offline, reconnect, and confirm the cart reconciles with the server.

limitations: Load and security testing were out of scope for this cycle and require separate authorization.
Offline cart sync was validated only on the primary reconnect path; secondary carrier failover is untested.

recommendation.rationale: All three release-blocking requirements have current-build passing coverage, the one major payment-retry defect was independently verified after a fix, and no blocker/critical defects remain open.

handoff.summary: QA recommends release; no deployment, merge, publication, environment change, defect closure, waiver, or release approval occurred.

steps.summary: Run the focused staging configuration test.
